title: Partner handshake
idea: Partner handshake: A clear eligibility statement leads into a concise relationship diagram and a scoped expression-of-interest form.
audience: People who need to explore partnership within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The visitor needs to understand obligations before contacting sales.
avoidWhen: The page would imply approved partner status before review.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic transaction layout through its explore partnership priority and explicit commitment contract: Submitting interest creates a request, never an approved partner account.
navigation: Partner handshake keeps the current explore partnership context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A clear eligibility statement leads into a concise relationship diagram and a scoped expression-of-interest form.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to explore partnership; the visitor needs to understand obligations before contacting sales.
composition.priority: Submitting interest creates a request, never an approved partner account.

imagery.role: Support the actual explore partnership context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Show requirements before form fields and preserve unfinished input.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the partner handshake structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no explore partnership content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Submitting interest creates a request, never an approved partner account.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized explore partnership content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Submitting interest creates a request, never an approved partner account.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active explore partnership context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
